lesson.meaning: Clearly separate and easy to recognize as different from others.
examples: The two projects have distinct goals, so we need different strategies for each.
When you listen carefully, you can hear a distinct difference between their accents.
During the presentation, she made three distinct points about the new marketing plan.
Our new software offers a distinct advantage over competitor products because of its user-friendly interface.
Each department has its own distinct responsibilities, which helps avoid overlap.
lesson.memory_tip: Remember 'distinct' means you can clearly see or hear that something is separate and different. Like two distinct colors – red and blue!
